case_title.quote: PARGAN SINGH V. STATE OF PUNJAB & ANR.

number_of_accused.quote: the two appellant challenge the veracity

accused_gender.reason: Accused are described as gentlemen, so male.

accused_religion.quote: two sikh gentlemen with trimmed beard
accused_religion.reason: Judgment describes the assailants as Sikh.

victim_gender.quote: Varun Kumar alias Kaka ... Kamaljit Singh

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the two perpetrators of the aforesaid crime were sikh gentlemen but unknown to the complainant or other persons
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Assailants were unknown to the victims.

offence_category.quote: convicted the appellants under Section 302, 397 as well as Section 307 IPC

statutory_provisions.quote: Section 302, 397 as well as Section 307 IPC read with Section 34 IPC

weapon.quote: started firing with pistol on Varun Kumar

evidence_type.quote: conviction is primarily based on the depositions of PW-1 to PW-3
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical and extra-judicial confession evidence.

confession.quote: even if for the sake of arguments, we discard the testimony of PW-1, the evidence of two eye-witnesses ... is sufficient
confession.reason: Confession accepted but described as weak and corroborated.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: shot dead Varun Kumar ... fired at PW-2 as well
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Facts noted by the court fit.

trial_court_outcome.quote: rigorous imprisonment of life and fine of Rs.50,000/- each

high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court has dismissed their appeals

final_outcome.quote: these appeals are bereft of any merit and are accordingly dismissed

offence_finally_established.quote: convicted the appellants under Section 302, 397 as well as Section 307 IPC read with Section 34

imprisonment_years.reason: Life sentence, so null is right.

fine_rs.correct_value: 75000 (50,000 under s.302 plus 25,000 under s.307, each accused)
fine_rs.quote: fine of Rs.50,000/- each ... fine of Rs.25,000/- is imposed
fine_rs.reason: Omits the Rs.25,000 fine under s.307; total is 75,000.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Both men fired at the victim; the pillion rider snatched the money bag and later fired at the companion who tried to stop them.
neutral_facts.quote: started firing with pistol on Varun Kumar ... The person sitting on the pillion of scooter, snatched the money bag
neutral_facts.reason: Wrongly says the pillion rider fired at the victim; he snatched the bag.

attempt_completion.quote: The gun shot injury led to death

physical_harm.quote: Multiple lacerated wounds 8 in number ... All injuries were caused with fire arm

number_of_offences.quote: offences for Section 302, 307 and 397 IPC read with Section 34 IPC

financial_property_loss.quote: withdrew a sum of Rs.4 lakhs ... also having one cheque book

motive.quote: snatched the money bag from Varun Kumar

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the evidence of two eye-witnesses who are found to be credible, is sufficient

post_offence_conduct.quote: the accused declined the same through separate statements

appeal_history.quote: the High Court has dismissed their appeals

prosecution_argument.quote: 90 seconds was more than sufficient time for these witnesses to observe

defence_argument.quote: appellants were falsely framed in the said crime
